verdict.rationale: HeyGen's pricing page lists 4K video export as its highest resolution, which covers the 1080p-or-above requirement natively. Nothing in the pack documents output aspect ratios such as 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented support for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 aspect ratios, documentation of resolution and aspect-ratio settings in the API or editor, and independent or hands-on confirmation that exports need no external re-encoding.
